name: Project Management
desc: Build a work-management platform — multi-view tracking, automation, and portfolio planning.
features:
## Core
- Multiple work views — List, Board/Kanban, Gantt/Timeline, Calendar, Workload
- Tasks & subtasks — assignees, custom fields, statuses, priorities
- Task dependencies & critical path
- No-code automation engine — trigger→condition→action with a recipe library
- Intake forms with conditional / branching logic
- Dashboards & reporting — real-time, filterable widget library
- Goals / OKRs linked to execution with task-to-objective rollup
- Native time tracking & budgeting
- Docs, wikis & whiteboards
- Templates / blueprints
- Role-based security, SSO & audit logs
- REST API + integrations

## Differentiators
- Portfolio management — cross-project rollup, resource & capacity planning, scenario/what-if
- Agile / sprint suite — backlog, sprints, scrum & kanban boards, burndown/velocity
- AI assistant — agentic actions, NL→automation/formula, AI summaries & status
- Cross-app enterprise search
